newsitem.title: CANADA: Strike deadline set at Air Canada unit.
newsitem.headline: Strike deadline set at Air Canada unit.

text.p: The union representing more than 200 customer sales and service agents, mechanics and ramp attendants employed by airOntario, a connector airline owned by Air Canada, said it set Thursday October 17 at 00:01 a.m. eastern time as a strike deadline.
Canadian Auto Workers union Local 2213 said it would meet with the company on October 15 and 16 in a final effort to reach a new collective agreement before the deadline.

Outstanding issues include wages and the utilisation of part-time employees. Members of CAW Local 2213 employed by airOntario voted 74 percent in favor of strike action, if necessary, on June 19, 1996.
The current collective agreement expired on June 30, 1996.
CAW members last struck airOntario in 1994. The strike lasted two weeks and caused major disruptions to the airline's operations and numerous cancellations.
